findings.value: A city farm on Buxton Street, E1, begun in 1978 on the site of a former railway depot. The farm says it is the closest city farm to the square mile of the City of London.

evidence.quote: Sited on a former railway goods depot, the Farm was started in 1978 in response to local people’s wishes
Spitalfields City Farm is the nearest city farm to the City of London’s square mile.

findings.value: The farm says its aim is to be a welcoming farm for all, connecting people of all ages to food, animals and nature.

evidence.quote: Our Purpose is to sustain and develop a welcoming city farm that connects people of all ages and culture to food, animals and nature.

notes: Only the farm's own pages were readable; no press review was found, so the summary and crowd rest on primary sources. The about page carries an annual report for 2024-25 but no page date, so no source_date is given. Opening hours and address are for the facts researcher.
